title: Coulda been soooo good!
text: Coulda been soooo good!. This is such a cool idea. The biggest bummer about the whole design though is that it will not stretch out between two studs. When I tried to use the included wall anchors, the screws were too small and the wall anchors were too big!! So I have two massive holes in my wall now. I had to strong arm this unit to the very max and screw my screws in at an angle so I could hit a stud. This means the middle of the rod is at its weakest point. The open and closing mechanism work great I wish the rods were solid. They are not they are hollow . I’ll use it for a little bit till I have to replace it.
